The adjusted tax rate is expected to be approximately 21%, and we now expect adjusted EPS of approximately 7%, tightening on our prior range of 6% to 8%.
Our cash from operations outlook remains approximately $1.175 billion.
And if we turn to the fourth quarter, we expect organic sales growth of approximately 4% and adjusted EPS is expected to increase 17% to 19% versus last year.
Third quarter adjusted EPS was $0.92, an increase of 13.6% versus last year, and it was above our outlook of $0.89.
Organic sales in the third quarter grew 5.1%, well above our outlook of approximately 3%.

guide.quote: And turning to the third quarter, we expect organic growth -- sales growth of approximately 3% and adjusted EPS of approximately $0.89 per share, representing approximately 10% growth versus the prior year, while we also invested approximately 12% rate of marketing as a percentage of sales.

source.quote: Net sales increased 1%, ahead of our outlook of a 1% decline.
